slot.intent: Reported profit outran real profit every year from 2020 to 2022, until the gap between them was 3.3 billion.

concept: Each spoken year raises its reported bar beside a hollow outline of the same height; the real bar rises into it and stops far short. As the gap is put at 3.3, the last outline turns red.
storyboard: 0.0 s, on "Reported": the kicker builds word by word in small tracked caps, REPORTED in the grey its bars wear and REAL in off white, the words between quieter; the baseline draws across
2.7 s, on "2020,": 2020 lands under the first pair; its reported bar climbs in grey beside a hollow dashed outline climbing with it, and 2.1 settles inside the bar's top
3.0 s: the real bar climbs in off white inside the outline and stops far short at 0.9, its figure settling inside its top; the empty part of the outline is the gap
4.0 s, on "2021,": the second pair does the same, 2.8 against 0.7, its gap taller
5.3 s, on "2022,": the third pair, 3.5 against 0.2, the tallest gap of the three
6.7 s, on "3.3": the last outline turns red, a plain tone change, and 3.3 lands in red inside it, the size of every other figure; the earlier gaps stay grey
Then a full hold on the finished chart to the end; the camera never moves

leansOn.title: Bar chart (this channel's approved version)
leansOn.why: Bars rise from a hairline baseline as their years are spoken, grey bars, small bold mono figures, a tracked caps kicker, no marks that carry no data.
